title: 43. Deduplicate at-least-once message delivery

examples.explanation: The second delivery of `a` is a duplicate: `ack`, with no second +2.
A failure before the commit: `retry`. The next delivery applies it.
Committed, but the acknowledgement was lost: `retry`. The redelivery is acknowledged without adding again.

hints: An acknowledgement can fail after the effect is already durable in the model.
Only the before failure leaves the ID unprocessed.
